page: OVHcloud l4-90 is a GPU-accelerated server belonging to the Cloud GPU family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9454 processor with 22 dedicated physical cores and 22 vCPUs running at 2.75 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 90.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 4.09 GB of memory per core. For acceleration, it features a single NVIDIA L4 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is provided by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the system operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% in stress-ng testing, and strong multi-core performance in the top 25%. The system excels in LLM inference tasks, achieving top-tier performance for both prompt processing and text generation using small and medium models. For large models, prompt processing remains strong, ranking in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations score in the average range, while Geekbench image processing and Passmark memory tests show strong performance.

From a resource density perspective, the l4-90 offers a balanced allocation of dedicated CPU cores and system memory alongside a modern, power-efficient L4 GPU. This configuration provides a cost-effective platform for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the overhead of multi-GPU setups. The server is highly suited for machine learning inference, image processing, multi-threaded data decompression, and compute-intensive applications requiring dedicated CPU resources.
description: OVHcloud l4-90 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for compute-intensive and machine learning workloads. It features an AMD EPYC 9454 processor with 22 dedicated physical cores, 90.0 GB of RAM, a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and a single NVIDIA L4 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the server delivers 8 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data highlights top-tier single-core CPU performance and exceptional LLM inference speeds, particularly for small and medium models. The system also demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and image processing performance. This hardware profile makes the l4-90 a highly efficient choice for machine learning inference, image processing, and parallel compute tasks.
